samples.label: Start with sample tasks

intro.sentence: Your tasks stay in Notion. Kan-do shows them as a board and saves changes back there.

help.intro: A short orientation before you enter anything.
help.token: You need a Notion token. It's stored on this device only.
help.database: Pick the database that holds your tasks. It must be shared with your integration.
help.mapping: Tell the app which property is the title, the status and the due date. Matching ones are preselected.
help.custom-properties: Optional: bring along more properties such as topic or activity.
help.priority-mapping: Match the values of your priority property to the three levels.
help.status-mapping: Last: which Notion status belongs to which column. Then you're set.

reminders.label: Connect with Apple Reminders
reminders.connectFailed: Connecting did not work. Check the access and try again.

help.access: macOS asks only once. Kan-do changes nothing until you plan something.
help.lists: You can change this later in Settings.

access.intro: Kan-do reads your Reminders and shows today's on the board. macOS will ask for your permission first.
access.previewText: “Kan-do reads your Reminders, shows today's on the board and sets the date when you plan something for today.”
access.whyText: macOS offers only all or nothing for Reminders. Kan-do reads your tasks, sets the date when you plan something for today, and ticks off what you finish.
access.neverText: Change titles or notes, create or delete tasks, change lists, or send anything to a server. It does not read lists you switch off.
access.listsFailedText: Access is granted, but Apple Reminders didn't return any lists. Try again.
access.waiting: macOS is asking. Answer in the macOS window.
access.granted: Access granted. Kan-do sees {n} list. | Access granted. Kan-do sees {n} lists.
access.deniedText: Allow it in System Settings under Privacy & Security › Reminders. Kan-do then checks again.

lists.help: When a list is on, its name becomes the topic of its tasks, such as taxes or housing. When it's off, Kan-do doesn't read it. In Apple Reminders it stays as it is.
lists.empty: All lists are off. Switch at least one on.
lists.none: Apple Reminders has no list yet. Create one there, then check again.

today.lead: The date in Apple Reminders decides what lands on your board today.
today.writes: When you plan a task for today in Kan-do, Kan-do sets its date to today. Time and alerts stay. Undo in the notice restores the old date.

review.introRelay: These details go to me and aren't published. Nothing leaves the app before that.

preview.title: Title

fallback.rejected: GitHub rejected the feedback token. Kan-do opens the feedback on GitHub in your browser instead.
fallback.rejectedCli: GitHub rejected the token of the GitHub CLI. Kan-do opens the feedback on GitHub in your browser instead. Sign in again with “gh auth login” and restart Kan-do.
fallback.overflow: Your text is very long. GitHub may not accept the link.

problem.offline: No connection. Your draft is kept.
problem.blocked: GitHub declined the request (limit or permissions). Try again later. Your draft is kept.
problem.server: GitHub is having trouble right now. Try again in a moment. Your draft is kept.
problem.unexpected: The feedback couldn't be created. Your draft is kept.
problem.uploadDenied: The image couldn't be uploaded. It goes to the clipboard and the feedback is created without it. Your draft is kept.
problem.clipboardFailed: The image couldn't be copied to the clipboard. You can take it again in the browser.
problem.relayBlocked: Too much feedback is arriving right now. Try again later. Your draft is kept.
problem.relayServer: The feedback couldn't be sent right now. Try again in a moment. Your draft is kept.
problem.relayUnexpected: The feedback couldn't be sent. Your draft is kept.
problem.relayDown: Sending directly isn't possible right now. Open the feedback on GitHub instead. Your draft is kept.
problem.relayImageTooLarge: The screenshot is too large to send. Clear its checkbox above and send again. Your draft is kept.
